Calculate the sum of range A1:A3 and report the result only. Do not write any destination cell.

Blank PPT confirms no text/slide-count mutation only; nonempty PPT content reading remains unverified.
Feedback strings are DOM textContent of collapsed activity summary and details, not evidence of two executions.
